systematic_findings: POST-CHECK/FORMATTER BUG (identity-changing journal alias): bibcheck/journal_key.xls maps 'psychonomic science' -> 'psychological science'; helpers.format_journal_name applies it, so the researcher's correct 'Psychonomic Science' was reverted on all 12 wave-6 entries that had it (AlleGart68, BjorEtal68, Blak67, BousRosn70, Crai68a, CrowMelt65, Dall65, FozaWaug69, Hinr68, Muth65, PeteJame67, Ster67a); they now carry Psychonomic Science DOIs under a journal founded in 1990. HEAD cdl.bib has 0 'Psychonomic Science' and 59 'Psychological Science' journals; pre-1990 ones are likely the same corruption. Same class of alias (a different journal, not a spelling variant), all in journal_key.xls: 'journal of the royal statistical society. series c (applied statistics)' -> 'journal of the optical society of america'; 'psychometric monographs' -> 'psychometrika'; 'j comp neurol' -> 'journal of computational neuroscience'; 'j comp physiol(a)' -> 'journal of computational physiology'; 'j exp psychol' -> 'journal of experimental psychology: general' (wrong pre-1975); 'proceedings of the naacl-hlt' -> 'proceedings of the national association for computational linguistics'; 'psychol forsch' -> 'psychologie forschung'. Typos in targets: 'phychophysiology', 'neuropyschology', 'journal of experiment psychology', 'artificial intellience', 'coysne'. Suggest adding these to preserve_identity (or deleting the rows) with a regression test on AlleGart68.
POST-CHECK/FORMATTER: alias 'physiological reviews' -> 'physiological review' reverts the correct journal name on DanPoo06, DestSejn03, Jeff95, Mitz85, Wang10 (Crossref: 'Physiological Reviews').

POST-CHECK (DOI title check) drops correct DOIs: Curr99 (Crossref title with glued lowercase words and mojibake for '/'), BousRosn70 (Crossref deposit typo 'unhibited', two letters off, plus 'vs' vs 'versus'), Mart65 (the ENTRY title has the typo 'paried'; the check compares against the uncorrected title because the researcher left title not_found). Suggest: normalise mojibake/non-ASCII punctuation to a separator, split lowercase-glued words against the entry's words, allow 'vs'='versus', and hold rather than drop when volume+first page+first author match.

POST-CHECK (surname hold): TrulEtal97 flagged 'meyer' -> 'j meyer' although the surname is unchanged (Crossref 'J.-A. Meyer' parsed with the hyphenated initial in the surname) - a false hold. Holds on obvious cdl.bib typos with one registry host (Trop86 Trope, CrosEtal93 Crosson, ParkEtal13 Ghosh, TulvThom73 Thomson) keep wrong values; TulvThom73 already has corroboration inside cdl.bib ('D M Thomson' in another entry), which the rule could count.

POST-CHECK (print-year rule) false alarms: WiggEtal99 (Crossref published-print 1998 vs PubMed DP 1999 Jan, cover date wins) and AdelEtal95 (Karger 2008 digitisation date read as a print date from the notes). The rule should not suggest a year when PubMed's DP equals the cited year.

RESEARCHER: MaguEtal96 dropped an initial (R S J -> R S) following PubMed, against the brief's 'never drop an initial'. MairEtal09a got a generic ICML booktitle instead of the Crossref container. Minor inconsistency: HanEtal24 moves '(Volume 1: Long Papers)' into volume, BorzEtal23a keeps '(Volume 3: System Demonstrations)' in booktitle; Royal Society journal names appear with and without the period ('London. Series {B}' in MaguEtal96/HuanEtal98 vs 'London Series {B}' elsewhere).
outside_review_set_findings: Psychonomic Science reverted on AlleGart68, Crai68a, CrowMelt65, Dall65, FozaWaug69, Hinr68, Muth65, PeteJame67, Ster67a (plus BjorEtal68, Blak67, BousRosn70 in the review set): suggested journal 'Psychonomic Science' for each.
